# Sugary Citrus — Full brand and service reference

## Overview
Sugary Citrus is an independent digital growth agency positioned around the tagline “Sweet Strategy. Sharp Execution.” The agency combines strategic thinking, creative execution and performance measurement to help ambitious brands improve their marketing.

## Services
### Performance Marketing
Paid media strategy, campaign setup, audience and offer research, creative testing, funnel observations and ongoing optimisation. Metrics may include CPA, ROAS, AOV and contribution, selected according to the business model.

### Creative Strategy
Customer and category research, messaging angles, UGC direction, creative briefs, production planning and iteration systems.

### SEO, AEO and GEO
Technical SEO foundations, crawlability, indexation, information architecture, intent-led content, helpful answer-oriented sections, structured data, entity consistency and machine-readable site information. No ranking or AI citation guarantees are made.

### Growth Strategy
Funnel reviews, offer positioning, measurement plans and prioritised experimentation roadmaps.

## Working principles
Start with the business problem. Understand the customer and economics. Make a clear plan. Test with discipline. Report what happened and what remains uncertain. Never fabricate outcomes, clients, reviews or credentials.

## Public identity
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sugarycitrus.co/
Website: https://sugarycitrus.in/


## AEO and GEO position
Search behaviour in India has shifted toward AI assistants. Sugary Citrus treats AEO and GEO as extensions of SEO rather than separate channels: make pages crawlable and indexed, answer the main question in the first paragraph, structure content with question-shaped headings and FAQs, include statistics and named sources, and keep brand facts consistent across the website, marketplaces, social profiles and third-party coverage. No ranking, mention or AI-citation guarantees are made.

## Published articles
- Why Indian D2C brands are missing from AI answers (and how to fix it in 2026) — /articles/aeo-geo-indian-d2c-brands-2026 — 2026-10-31. Topics: Indian AI shopping adoption, where AI engines source citations for Indian D2C brands, the seven moves that shift citations, a 30-day checklist, measurement and FAQs.
